'''2001 San Diego Comic-Con Open''' was a constructed Star Wars CCG Open tournament at Comic-Con in San Diego, California, in July 2001. [[Michael Girard]] won it, going 10–0.<ref name="dt-17823">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/17823 Watch Your Phil - ComiCon winning Light deck], DeckTech (Michael "Dvader" Girard, 26 July 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/17823/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/17823/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Dates:''' 20 July 2001<ref name="tr-d2707" />
* '''Site:''' Comic-Con, San Diego, California
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Tatooine]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Michael Girard]]
* '''Players:''' 77<ref name="tr-d2707" />

The month comes from the players' DeckTech posts of 26–30 July 2001, which describe the event as just played; the exact days are not given. The event was played before [[Coruscant (expansion)|Coruscant]] was tournament legal.

Girard posted both of his decks as the ones he used to go 10–0 through the Open.<ref name="dt-17823" /><ref name="dt-17824" /> Berta took 2nd; he lost to Girard's Watch Your Step deck after winning the podrace and having Girard down to 7 Life Force.<ref name="dt-17900" /> Ishimaru's Dark deck went 3–1, losing only to a podracing deck.<ref name="dt-17947" />
